item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.9
item.description: Attach multiple screenshots to one dictation. The overlay shows smaller previews, and screenshots paste in capture order. You can copy images individually when a destination accepts one at a time. Turn on Save screenshot dictations as captures in Settings → Dictation to keep the transcript and screenshots together in one local note. Text-only dictation still pastes.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.10
item.description: Screenshot dictation now delivers images to Slack for Mac in capture order and lets you recover interrupted pastes. In Herdr, press Command-V to paste the screenshot files, then choose Copy Text to paste the transcript. Suggested-work previews and their editors now resize with the capture pane.
